_meta.name: preliminary_v2_2026-11-16
_meta.description: Corrected hardware-team information (16 Nov, second report). Battery corrected from the earlier misreported 2 x 12 V 120 Ah to 2 x 12.8 V 10 Ah LiFePO4 in parallel = 256 Wh nominal. Travel power 15 W re-classified as MEASURED (battery current sensor, preliminary). Speed unchanged. Usable capacity and reserve remain PROVISIONAL ASSUMPTIONS for exploratory runs; cargo, unloading, charging and excavation remain synthetic.
_meta.supersedes: preliminary_2026-11-16 (config/rover_calibration_preliminary.json) - kept for comparison, do not use
_meta.warning: NOT PHYSICALLY VALIDATED. Replace entries as the data-collection workbook is filled in.

speed_m_per_min.source: Hardware team: physical speed setting 1 = 0.035 m/s (setting 1 will be used for the demonstration)
speed_m_per_min.uncertainty: PRELIMINARY: single reported value; trial count and method unknown; confirmation trials planned
speed_m_per_min.notes: Consistent with the twin repo note 'real rover ~0.035 m/s at level 1'. Simulated speeds are not used.

travel_power_w.source: Hardware team: battery current sensor reading during actual driving, ~15 W
travel_power_w.uncertainty: PRELIMINARY: trial count, load state, surface and averaging window not reported; repeatability trials still needed
travel_power_w.notes: Implies 0.119 Wh per metre at 2.1 m/min (synthetic was 0.200). Previously (v1) carried as an ASSUMED component estimate; now re-classified per hardware team.

battery_capacity_wh.source: PROVISIONAL: 80% of nominal 256 Wh (2 x 12.8 V x 10 Ah LiFePO4, parallel)
battery_capacity_wh.uncertainty: Usable fraction is a generic LiFePO4 depth-of-discharge assumption, not a discharge test; BMS limits unconfirmed
battery_capacity_wh.notes: Justification: LiFePO4 packs are commonly cycled to 80-90% depth of discharge; 80% is the conservative end. Replace with the Charge_Tests discharge result. See sensitivity analysis for 70-100%.

battery_wh.source: Assume full (= usable capacity) at mission start

reserve_wh.source: PROVISIONAL: 10% of nominal 256 Wh, as suggested by hardware team
reserve_wh.uncertainty: NOT an approved safety threshold; the physical BMS cutoff is unknown
reserve_wh.notes: Scheduling reserve only; never a physical safety limit. See sensitivity analysis for 5-20%.

capacity_kg.source: Retained synthetic value; no cargo bin measurement yet

unload_min.source: Retained synthetic value; no dump mechanism timed

charging_power_w.source: Retained synthetic value; charger not characterised
charging_power_w.notes: A 100 W charger would refill 204.8 Wh in ~2 h; charging inside a 120-min sol is therefore possible only for small top-ups. Real charger unknown.

default_excavation_power_w.source: Retained synthetic value; rover cannot excavate

nominal_battery.usable_capacity_wh: UNKNOWN - requires discharge test (Charge_Tests sheet); 204.8 Wh assumed above
nominal_battery.correction_note: First report (v1) stated 2 x 12 V 120 Ah = 2880 Wh; corrected to 2 x 12.8 V 10 Ah = 256 Wh. The '10 A' figure in the first report most likely referred to the 10 Ah rating.

policy.reserve_fraction_status: suggested by hardware team, NOT approved

not_modelled.turning: Physical turn time/energy not measured; simulator assumes zero. Simulated-rover values are simulation settings and are not used.
not_modelled.speed_settings_2_3: not measured; setting 1 will be used for the demonstration
not_modelled.loaded_vs_unloaded_power: not measured; simulator uses one travel power
not_modelled.idle_power: not measured; simulator assumes 0 while unloading/charging
not_modelled.battery_telemetry: Rover sensors can report voltage and current (hardware team). How readings reach the scheduling software is NOT yet defined; no telemetry integration exists.
